t: This seventeen-storey office block is the News Building, part of the Shard Quarter development at London Bridge. It houses News UK's London operations, including The Times, The Sunday Times, The Sun, Times Radio and the publisher HarperCollins. Qatar, which is behind the Shard Quarter, financed it. The architect was Renzo Piano, who also designed The Shard across the piazza. Adamson Associates served as executive architect.
